title: Independent audit of PLAY-03 live synthetic transport and reconnect and Director-requested integration into main
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Audited Codex commits 6f3b45e (PLAY-03, CHG-20261014-006) and 743f0b2 (packaging correction CHG-20261015-001) against ADR0015, the live contract, the runbook, the intake/plan and the backlog acceptance (two real clients complete a game, reconnect on a different host and resolve a duplicate pending command). Review covered: closed protocol 2 schemas and frame bounds beside unchanged diagnostic protocol 1; ticket issue/consume SQL (participant/release/protocol join, SHA-256 storage, atomic single-use DELETE bound to origin and expiry); gateway admission order, exact Origins and synchronous per-actor reservation; session rechecks before and after each projection; submitRefs hashing the original reference intent in its own namespace before resolution, with worker-side resolution against the same checkpoint; the projection cache key over the exact committed row plus viewer and policy, authorization before cache; COMMIT-only NOTIFY with polling reconciliation; heartbeat, backpressure and drain; the browser client's generation/disposal guards and pending-intent export/restore; additive migration 0004. PLAY-02 follow-ups 1 (resolver-only client commands) and 3 (per-version caching and limits) are closed for this scope. Verdict: PLAY-03 acceptance is met for the agreed synthetic/test-session scope; no blocking finding.

Independent runs RUN-20261015-012..017 all passed at Codex's final fingerprint 64bef2e3 with exact timing, no clock discontinuity and 0 redactions. RUN012: full verify:foundation (324 project checks = 300 Node + 24 Python; 406 upstream passes/1 inherited skip; 2 injection). RUN013: auditor live gateway probe on the real test database: ticket HTTP refusals (missing/wrong Origin, no session, query URL, extra field, oversize, protocol 1, identical outsider/missing-match 403), no-store exact-origin responses, hash-only storage and the 12-per-minute quota; WebSocket refusals (wrong Origin, URL ticket left unconsumed, replay, cross-origin ticket, expired, revoked session, non-authenticate first frame, malformed ticket, 301 ms auth deadline, re-authentication, other match) without durable writes; a complete 48-version two-host game across 8 move types driven only by current references with 92 byte-equal wire/adapter snapshot comparisons; durable invalid_intent for unknown, opponent, cross-viewer, previous-version and opponent-ink-back references and an out-of-turn move, stale for an old version; socket closure without receipt for raw engine identity, manual move, extra field, actor override and changed payload under a reused command ID; one commit for a concurrent identical command on two hosts; lost acknowledgement retried with old references after two later commits returns the saved receipt; revocation (4401), drain (1012) and heartbeat loss (1013) withhold frames without conceding; 6 of 14 rapid commands rate-limited without writes; 223 frames with closed envelopes, consecutive sequences and no seed/commitment/digest/engine identifier/session/cookie/ticket; 48 NOTIFY payloads carrying only the match ID. RUN014: auditor cache probe: warm and cold 48-way bursts use at most one projection (PLAY-02 audit: 34 served/14 refused), viewers never share entries, authorization precedes cache, cross-instance commits visible immediately, 80 concurrent reads serve 64 and refuse 16, four forged rows fail closed instead of hitting the cache, raw/reference namespaces conflict both ways, rejected retries are duplicates, raw identities via references are rejected, restart reproduces. RUN015: auditor boundary/startup/migration probe: six browser owners including match-client refuse 528 server/gateway/db/runtime/pg/Fastify/Node imports, client depends on and imports only contracts with no storage/cookies, 48 browser files free of 23 server markers, ordinary startup unchanged with no ticket/play/login routes and protocol 1 negotiation, engine/adapter/Lab/vendor/protocol/viewer contracts byte-identical to main, 0001-0003 unchanged and 0004 additive with match-only privileges in both databases. RUN016: Codex database suites (5 + 3 + 27, eight identities). RUN017: Chromium 8 scenarios + 2 Lab workers. RUN018: docs:check covers this record.

Verified the append-only packaging correction: sealed CHG-20261014-006 lists 4 files and CHG-20261015-001 lists exactly the 195 paths of git diff main..HEAD with none missing or extra. git diff --check reports only the disclosed extra blank line at the end of apps/match-service/tests/live-fixtures.mjs; it is cosmetic and left unchanged because editing it would alter the tested fingerprint. A scan of the branch diff and the new audit logs against private configuration values found no credential; the only match is the database name inside a role-name pattern on an unchanged context line already published on main.

Follow-ups recorded, none blocking: (1) AUTH-01 sizing: each 500 ms reconciliation tick calls SessionAuthority.verify for every connection plus once per match group, about three calls per second per socket (roughly 380/s at the 128-socket cap); verification must be cheap or cached within the accepted revocation delay. (2) PostgreSQL does not access-control LISTEN; the api role can subscribe to lorcana_match_changed, so NOTIFY payloads must stay metadata-only. (3) Abandoned quota keys are not pruned; the test database holds 31 expired rows from 2026-10-14 23:23-23:28 UTC development runs; OPS must add retention before production. (4) Carried from PLAY-02: per-move transcript replay (about 0.2-0.26 s per synthetic command), the 4,096-event projection bound, identity-independent outcomes for opponent ink-back references, card-certification visibility review and the Lab/lock-file pending_PLAY-02 labels.

Appended a dated independent-audit section to docs/validation/play-03.md and dated audit notes to ADR0015, the PLAY-03 plan and the live-matches runbook. Added the audit sentence to the PLAY-03 paragraph of AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/README.md. Rewrote HANDOFF for the audit and integration sequence. features.json and FEATURES.md note the audit for F-LIVE-TRANSPORT, F-MATCH-CLIENT and F-MATCH-COMMANDS with the audit evidence; the PLAY-03 backlog row links this record with status unchanged. CHANGELOG and current-state regenerated by docs:sync.
